verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sandboxes as isolated test environments that don't affect the live integration. Identity also ships its own test-mode flow, with predefined test cases (including failure cases) and a separate test dashboard for verification sessions. This lets users test without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Identity testing in sandboxes, and a dedicated Identity testing page (the test flows are only embedded in the integration guide).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A sandbox is an isolated test environment. You can use your sandbox to test Stripe functionality in your account, and experiment with new features without affecting your live integration
Submit the session by selecting a predefined test case
